expectations.text: Pushes back on requires_action / pending as status names because they name the consumer's next step (future tense) not the resource's present condition
expectations.evidence: 'don't add requires_action. It's the classic trap — it names the consumer's to-do list... the future tense in a status field.' Also flags pending as non-discriminating.

expectations.text: Recommends a present-condition status such as authentication_required, leading with the missing thing rather than requires_authentication
expectations.evidence: status charge.authentication_required; 'authentication_required reads as a condition... Lead with the missing thing.'

expectations.text: Puts the actionable part (the challenge link / do-this) in an issue, not in the status
expectations.evidence: Challenge URL in issue links.api; 'the instruction lives in the layer designed for instructions.'

expectations.text: Notes failure should loop back to a recoverable state rather than being terminal
expectations.evidence: Failed/abandoned challenge returns to charge.unpaid, not terminal failed; reserve failed for retries exhausted.
